recipes.title: Fluffy pancakes
recipes.blurb: Tall, tender stacks with butter and maple syrup

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir just until mixed. A few lumps are fine.
Let the batter rest while you heat a skillet over medium heat.
Grease the pan with a little butter. Pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles cover the top and the edges look dry.
Cook until golden underneath, about 1 minute. Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Buttermilk pancakes
recipes.blurb: Tangy, fluffy diner-style pancakes

ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter in a second bowl.
Pour the wet into the dry. Stir until just combined; lumps are fine.
Rest the batter while a buttered skillet heats over medium.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form and the edges look set.
Flip and cook until golden brown on the second side.
Serve hot with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Blueberry pancakes
recipes.blurb: Fluffy pancakes studded with juicy blueberries

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg, melted butter and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet into the dry until just mixed. Gently fold in the blueberries.
Heat a buttered skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles pop and edges look dry.
Flip and cook until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Chocolate chip pancakes
recipes.blurb: A weekend treat the kids ask for by name

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg, melted butter and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet into the dry until just mixed. Do not overmix.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip.
Cook the second side until golden. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Banana oat blender pancakes
recipes.blurb: Whole-grain pancakes made in the blender

steps.text: Add the oats, bananas, eggs, milk, baking powder, cinnamon and salt to a blender.
Blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.
Let the batter sit so the oats can soften.
Heat a buttered skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook until golden and set in the middle.
Serve with sliced banana and syrup.

recipes.title: Classic waffles
recipes.blurb: Crisp outside, light inside, ready for syrup

steps.text: Heat the waffle iron and brush or spray it with cooking spray.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla in another bowl.
Pour the wet into the dry. Stir until just combined.
Pour batter onto the iron, about 3/4 cup for a standard iron, and close it.
Cook until golden and steam slows.
Keep waffles warm on a rack in a 200°F oven while you finish the batter.

recipes.title: Sheet pan pancakes
recipes.blurb: Bake the whole family's pancakes at once

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush a 13x18-inch rimmed baking sheet with 2 tbsp melted butter.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the milk, eggs, vanilla and remaining melted butter. Stir into the dry mix.
Pour the batter onto the pan and spread it evenly. Scatter the blueberries on top.
Bake until puffed and golden at the edges.
Cut into squares and serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Classic French toast
recipes.blurb: Custardy middles, golden edges, cinnamon

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and sugar in a shallow dish.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Soak each bread slice about 20 seconds per side, then let extra drip off.
Cook the bread until golden brown on the first side.
Flip and cook until golden and cooked through.
Wipe the pan and add more butter between batches. Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Dutch baby
recipes.blurb: A puffy oven pancake with lemon and powdered sugar

steps.text: Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven. Heat the oven to 425°F.
Blend the eggs, milk, flour, sugar and salt until smooth.
Carefully add the butter to the hot skillet and swirl until melted.
Pour the batter into the hot pan right away.
Bake until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the door early.
Squeeze lemon over the top and dust with powdered sugar. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Easy crepes
recipes.blurb: Thin, tender crepes to fill with fruit or jam

steps.text: Blend the flour, eggs, milk, water, melted butter, sugar and salt until smooth.
Rest the batter so the crepes are tender.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush with butter.
Pour in 1/4 cup batter and tilt the pan so it spreads thin.
Cook until the edges lift and the bottom is lightly golden.
Flip and cook briefly. Stack the crepes on a plate.
Fill with strawberries, roll up and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy scrambled eggs
recipes.blurb: Low and slow for soft, custardy curds

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until fully blended.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs. Let them sit for 20 seconds.
Gently push the eggs across the pan with a spatula, forming soft curds.
Take the pan off the heat while the eggs still look slightly wet.
Serve right away; they keep cooking on the plate.

recipes.title: Fluffy cheese omelet
recipes.blurb: A diner classic, golden outside and melty inside

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, water, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in half the eggs. As the edges set, pull them toward the center.
Tilt the pan so the runny egg flows underneath. Cook until barely set.
Sprinkle half the cheese over one side and fold the other side over it.
Slide onto a plate. Repeat for the second omelet.

recipes.title: Denver omelet
recipes.blurb: Ham, peppers and onion folded into fluffy eggs

steps.text: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the ham, pepper and onion until the vegetables are soft.
Move the filling to a plate. Whisk the eggs with the water, salt and pepper.
Melt the remaining butter in the pan and pour in the eggs.
Cook until the eggs are mostly set, lifting the edges to let runny egg flow under.
Add the filling and cheese to one half, fold over, and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Spinach and feta frittata
recipes.blurb: Stovetop to oven; great warm or cold

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion until soft.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Pour the eggs over the vegetables and sprinkle with feta.
Cook on the stove until the edges set, then move the pan to the oven.
Bake until the center is set and no longer jiggles.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice into wedges.

recipes.title: Ham and cheese egg muffin cups
recipes.blurb: Make-ahead protein bites for busy mornings

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Divide the ham, pepper and cheese among the muffin cups.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the fillings, filling each cup about 3/4 full.
Bake until the eggs are set and puffed.
Cool 5 minutes, then run a knife around each cup to loosen.
Store leftovers in the fridge up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.blurb: Eggs poached in spicy tomato and pepper sauce

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika and pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Top with feta and cilantro. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros
recipes.blurb: Crispy tortillas, black beans, salsa and fried eggs

steps.text: Warm the black beans with the cumin and a splash of water in a small pot; mash lightly.
Crisp the tortillas in 2 tbsp oil in a skillet, 1 minute per side. Drain on paper towels.
Warm the salsa in a small pan.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set. Season with salt.
Top two tortillas per plate with beans, two eggs and salsa.
Finish with avocado and crumbled queso fresco.

recipes.title: Eggs in a basket
recipes.blurb: Egg fried right inside a slice of toast

steps.text: Cut a 2-inch hole in the center of each bread slice with a cup or cutter.
Butter both sides of the bread, including the cut-out rounds.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 slice of bread.
Crack an egg into the hole and season with salt and pepper.
Cook until the white is set, then flip carefully.
Cook the second side until the egg is done as you like.
Toast the cut-out rounds alongside for dipping.

recipes.title: Loaded breakfast hash
recipes.blurb: Crispy potatoes, sausage and peppers topped with eggs

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the potatoes, stirring now and then, until golden and tender.
Add the sausage, onion and pepper. Cook until the sausage reaches 160°F.
Season with the salt and pepper and stir well.
Make 4 wells in the hash and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve from the pan.

recipes.title: Overnight cinnamon French toast bake
recipes.blurb: Assemble tonight, bake tomorrow

steps.text: Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish and fill it with the bread cubes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla, 1 tsp cinnamon and sugar. Pour over the bread.
Press the bread down, cover and chill overnight.
Next morning, heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the brown sugar, flour and 1 tsp cinnamon. Cut in the cold butter until crumbly. Sprinkle on top.
Bake uncovered until puffed, golden and set in the middle.
Rest 10 minutes and serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Sausage hash brown breakfast casserole
recipes.blurb: Cheesy, hearty and easy to feed a crowd

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Brown the sausage in a skillet until it reaches 160°F. Drain and crumble.
Spread the hash browns in the dish. Top with sausage and 1.5 cups cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour over everything.
Bake until the center is set and the top is golden.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake 3 more minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, then cut and serve.

recipes.title: Ham and cheese strata
recipes.blurb: Savory bread pudding with Swiss and Dijon

steps.text: Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish. Layer in half the bread, ham and cheese, then repeat.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over the layers.
Press down, cover, and chill so the bread soaks up the custard.
Heat the oven to 350°F.
Bake uncovered until puffed, golden and a knife in the center comes out clean.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Mushroom and spinach egg bake
recipes.blurb: Vegetarian egg casserole that reheats well

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the mushrooms and onion until browned.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted. Spread in the dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour over the vegetables and top with cheese.
Bake until the center is set and the top is lightly golden.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Biscuit and sausage gravy bake
recipes.blurb: Everything good about biscuits and gravy in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cut each biscuit into quarters.
Brown the sausage in a skillet until it reaches 160°F. Do not drain.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk.
Simmer, stirring, until thick. Add pepper and salt.
Toss the biscuit pieces with the gravy in the dish. Top with cheese.
Bake until the biscuits are cooked through and golden.
Cool 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast enchilada bake
recipes.blurb: Eggs, sausage and cheese rolled up in red sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Brown the sausage until it reaches 160°F. Drain.
Scramble the eggs with the salt in a skillet until just set. Mix in the sausage.
Fill each tortilla with the egg mixture and a little cheese. Roll and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour the enchilada sauce over the top and cover with the remaining cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Top with green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Crescent roll breakfast bake
recipes.blurb: Flaky crust, sausage, egg and cheddar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9x13-inch dish and press the crescent dough into the bottom, sealing the seams.
Brown the sausage until it reaches 160°F. Drain well.
Spread the sausage and cheese over the dough.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour evenly over the top.
Bake until puffed, golden and set in the center.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Ham and potato breakfast bake
recipes.blurb: Roasted potatoes under a cheesy egg custard

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with the oil, half the salt and the pepper on a pan, then pour into a 9x13-inch dish.
Roast the potatoes until tender and lightly browned.
Reduce the oven to 375°F. Stir in the ham, pepper and onion.
Whisk the eggs, milk and remaining salt. Pour over and top with cheese.
Bake until the eggs are set in the center.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Cinnamon roll casserole
recipes.blurb: Gooey cinnamon rolls baked in vanilla custard

ingredients.item: refrigerated cinnamon rolls with icing (12.4 oz)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cut each cinnamon roll into 8 pieces. Set the icing aside. Scatter the pieces in the dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon and brown sugar. Pour over the pieces.
Let the pieces soak while the oven finishes heating.
Bake until puffed and golden with no wet spots in the middle.
Cool 10 minutes, then drizzle with the icing.

recipes.title: Egg and cheese English muffin
recipes.blurb: The drive-thru classic, made at home

steps.text: Split and toast the English muffins. Butter them lightly.
Melt the remaining butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Crack in the eggs. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until the whites set, then flip and cook the yolks to your liking.
Lay a cheese slice on each egg for the last 30 seconds so it melts.
Set each egg on a muffin bottom, cap with the top and serve warm.

recipes.title: Sausage, egg and cheese biscuits
recipes.blurb: Flaky biscuits with sausage patties and fried eggs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Bake the biscuits on a sheet pan as the package directs.
Cook the sausage patties in a skillet over medium heat until 160°F inside.
Fry the eggs in the same pan until the whites are set and season with salt and pepper.
Split the warm biscuits.
Layer each bottom with a patty, an egg and a cheese slice.
Add the biscuit tops and serve at once.

recipes.title: Freezer breakfast burritos
recipes.blurb: Make a batch, freeze, microwave on busy mornings

steps.text: Brown the sausage until it reaches 160°F. Drain.
Cook the hash browns in a skillet until golden and warmed through.
Scramble the eggs with salt and pepper until just set.
Combine the sausage, hash browns, eggs and cheese. Cool slightly.
Divide among the warm tortillas. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Wrap each in foil or parchment and freeze in a bag up to 3 months.
To reheat, microwave unwrapped from frozen 2 to 3 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Bacon, egg and avocado wrap
recipes.blurb: Warm tortilla, scrambled egg, bacon and creamy avocado

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Scramble the eggs in the butter over medium-low heat until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave.
Fill each with eggs, bacon, cheese, avocado and salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll up. Slice in half.

recipes.title: Ham and cheese breakfast sliders
recipes.blurb: Sweet rolls, ham and Swiss with a buttery glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Slice the rolls in half as one slab and set the bottoms in a 9x13-inch dish.
Layer the ham and cheese on the bottoms and replace the top slab.
Stir the butter, mustard and poppy seeds. Brush it over the rolls.
Cover with foil and bake until the cheese melts.
Remove the foil and bake until the tops are golden.
Cut into 12 sliders and serve warm.

recipes.title: Sheet pan egg sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Bake all the eggs at once for easy sandwiches

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour into the pan.
Bake until the eggs are set in the center.
Toast the English muffins while the eggs cool for a few minutes.
Cut the eggs into 6 squares.
Build each sandwich with Canadian bacon, an egg square and cheese between the muffin halves.

recipes.title: Breakfast quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crispy tortillas filled with eggs, beans and cheese

steps.text: Scramble the eggs with the salt in the butter until just set.
Spread cheese over half of each tortilla. Add eggs and a few beans.
Fold each tortilla in half.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil.
Cook each quesadilla until golden and crisp.
Flip and cook until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon bagels
recipes.blurb: Cream cheese, lox, cucumber and capers

steps.text: Split and toast the bagels until golden.
Spread each half with cream cheese.
Layer the smoked salmon over the bottoms.
Top with cucumber, red onion and capers.
Sprinkle with dill, close the sandwiches and serve.

recipes.title: Veggie egg and pesto sandwich
recipes.blurb: Fried egg, spinach and tomato with basil pesto

steps.text: Split and toast the English muffins. Spread the cut sides with pesto.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set. Season with salt.
Layer spinach, tomato and provolone on each muffin bottom.
Warm the sandwiches under the broiler or in the pan until the cheese melts.
Top each with an egg and the muffin top.

recipes.title: Blueberry muffins
recipes.blurb: Tender, bakery-style muffins with a domed top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, oil, eggs and vanilla in another bowl.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined. Fold in the blueberries.
Divide the batter among the cups, filling them nearly full.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Banana bread
recipes.blurb: Moist and easy, a way to use up spotty bananas

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Mix the melted butter, brown sugar, eggs, mashed bananas and vanilla.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet until just combined.
Scrape the batter into the pan.
Bake until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Cinnamon streusel coffee cake
recipes.blurb: Sour cream cake with a thick crumb topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9-inch square pan.
Mix the brown sugar, 1/2 cup flour and cinnamon. Cut in 4 tbsp cold butter until crumbly.
Whisk 2 cups flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Beat the softened butter, eggs, sour cream and vanilla. Stir in the dry mix.
Spread the batter in the pan and sprinkle with the streusel.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Cranberry cream scones
recipes.blurb: Buttery wedges with tart dried cranberries

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Cut in the butter until crumbly.
Stir in the cranberries. Whisk the egg with 1/2 cup cream and stir in until a dough forms.
Pat the dough into an 8-inch round and cut into 8 wedges.
Set the wedges on the pan and brush with the remaining cream.
Bake until golden brown.
Cool a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon poppy seed muffins
recipes.blurb: Bright citrus muffins with a crisp top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and poppy seeds.
Whisk the eggs, milk, oil, lemon zest and 1/4 cup lemon juice.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined.
Divide the batter among the cups.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes in the pan, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Cheddar chive drop biscuits
recipes.blurb: No rolling, no cutting, just stir and scoop

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder.
Stir the melted butter into the cold milk; it will clump a little.
Pour into the dry mix. Add the cheese and chives and stir until just combined.
Drop heaping scoops of dough onto the pan.
Bake until golden brown on top.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Cinnamon sugar muffins
recipes.blurb: Doughnut-style muffins rolled in cinnamon sugar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or use liners.
Whisk the flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Whisk 5 tbsp melted butter, milk and egg. Stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Divide the batter among the cups.
Bake until lightly golden and set.
Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon on a plate.
Dip each warm muffin top in melted butter, then roll it in the cinnamon sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate chip banana muffins
recipes.blurb: Ripe bananas and melty chocolate in every bite

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix the mashed bananas, brown sugar, egg, oil and vanilla.
Stir the wet into the dry until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Divide the batter among the cups.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Berry overnight oats
recipes.blurb: Stir together tonight, grab and go tomorrow

steps.text: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup and vanilla in a bowl.
Divide between two jars or containers.
Cover and chill until the oats are soft and creamy.
Stir well in the morning. Add a splash of milk if too thick.
Top with the berries and serve cold.

recipes.title: Oatmeal with cinnamon apples
recipes.blurb: Creamy oats topped with warm sauteed apples

steps.text: Bring the milk, water and salt to a simmer in a saucepan.
Stir in the oats and cook, stirring often, until creamy.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the apples with the cinnamon and brown sugar until tender.
Spoon the oatmeal into bowls and top with the apples.

recipes.title: Baked apple cinnamon oatmeal
recipes.blurb: Cake-like oatmeal you slice and reheat all week

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray an 8x8-inch baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Whisk the milk, eggs, maple syrup and melted butter.
Stir the apples into the oats, spread in the dish and pour the milk mixture over. Top with walnuts.
Bake until set and golden.
Cool 10 minutes. Serve warm with milk or yogurt.

recipes.title: Berry yogurt parfaits
recipes.blurb: Layers of Greek yogurt, granola and fresh berries

steps.text: Stir the honey into the yogurt.
Spoon a layer of yogurt into 4 glasses.
Add a layer of granola and a layer of berries.
Repeat the layers once more.
Top with the remaining berries and granola. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Berry banana smoothie
recipes.blurb: Thick, creamy and ready in five minutes

steps.text: Add the milk and yogurt to a blender first.
Add the banana, frozen berries and honey.
Blend on high until completely smooth, about 1 minute.
Add a splash of milk if it is too thick. Pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Tropical green smoothie
recipes.blurb: Spinach hides behind sweet pineapple and banana

steps.text: Pour the orange juice into a blender.
Add the spinach, then the pineapple, banana and ice.
Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.
Taste and add a little more juice if you want it thinner. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Avocado toast with eggs
recipes.blurb: Smashed avocado, lemon and a runny egg

steps.text: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and half the salt.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Spread the avocado on the toast.
Top each with an egg, the remaining salt and a pinch of pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Sweet potato breakfast bowls
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potato, black beans, egg and avocado

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and pepper with the oil, paprika and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast, stirring once, until the potatoes are tender and browned.
Warm the black beans in a small pot.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Divide the potatoes and beans among 4 bowls.
Top each with an egg and avocado, then squeeze lime over.

recipes.title: Vanilla chia pudding
recipes.blurb: Creamy dairy-free pudding with fresh mango

steps.text: Whisk the chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup and vanilla in a bowl.
Wait 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up clumps.
Cover and chill until thick and pudding-like.
Stir well. Add a splash of milk if it is too thick.
Spoon into cups and top with the diced mango.
